feedback.frank: REFINE: retain loop-of-loops as OPEN dynamical architecture; require explicit loop scheduling class and distinguish resource-budget exhaustion from semantic completion. H1 must validate on frozen replay.
feedback.clayresearch: REFINE: generic structured recurrence remains preferred over FRANK-specific syntax; add epoch/order semantics to compiler/runtime convergence work.
feedback.harness: TEST: H1 should compare snapshot/set-like, declared sequential and event-driven/asynchronous lowering where dependency semantics differ; classify exhausted-budget/high-residual as STALLED/ESCALATE.
feedback.claygraph: NO_SCHEMA_CHANGE: epoch-bound topology/receipts already support derived loop coupling; preserve activation != truth. Scheduling class should be represented/provenanced, not inferred from graph iteration order.
feedback.unifieddb: NO_PHYSICAL_CHANGE: persist loop scheduling contract, epoch, budget-exit reason and replay receipt in the existing semantic plane.
feedback.gwt: NO_SEMANTIC_COLLAPSE: recurrence continuation/halt is not broadcast/use/effect/reentry authority; budget exhaustion cannot imply successful cognitive completion.
feedback.hyperposition: NO_CHANGE: preserved alternatives remain compatible; ordered vs set-like recurrence must not erase explicit competing branches.
feedback.emergenz: NO_PROMOTION: schedule determinism and recurrent stability are observability/control properties, not emergence evidence.
feedback.claycode: BUILD: production generic structured-control IR plus explicit scheduling semantics (snapshot/set-like vs ordered/sequential/asynchronous), typed halt reasons, translation validation and external effect-permit revalidation.

shared_mission_delta: This narrows BASE work toward compiler/runtime realization. It does not advance a gate and does not justify new cognitive syntax.
